description.text: The course can be taught in English, and the tuition fee is 30% higher.

duration.text: The Environmental Engineering at Beijing Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6333 USD/per year ￥ 45600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Permission from the previous university for tranfer students A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university. 8. Guardian’s Guarantee Only for applicants under 18 years old.

requirements.text: Doctoral program applicant should have a master's Dgree in the same major or in the relative field of interest.
